message_attachments_lifecycle_check.name: message_attachments_lifecycle_check
message_attachments_lifecycle_check.value:
(
      ("message_attachments"."status" = 'pending' AND "message_attachments"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "message_attachments"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "message_attachments"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("message_attachments"."status" = 'consumed' AND "message_attachments"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "message_attachments"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("message_attachments"."status" = 'retained' AND "message_attachments"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "message_attachments"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("message_attachments"."status" = 'deleted' AND "message_attachments"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)
    )

groups_system_owner_check.name: groups_system_owner_check
groups_system_owner_check.value: ("groups"."is_system" = true AND "groups"."owner_id" IS NULL) OR ("groups"."is_system" = false AND "groups"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL)

room_events_single_transition_link.name: room_events_single_transition_link
room_events_single_transition_link.value: NOT ("room_events"."supersedes_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "room_events"."resolves_event_id" IS NOT NULL)

room_journal_state_historical_range.name: room_journal_state_historical_range
room_journal_state_historical_range.value: "room_journal_state"."historical_backfill_cursor_message_id" IS NULL OR "room_journal_state"."historical_backfill_target_message_id" IS NULL OR "room_journal_state"."historical_backfill_cursor_message_id" <= "room_journal_state"."historical_backfill_target_message_id"

uq_relay_tokens_user_installation_active.name: uq_relay_tokens_user_installation_active
uq_relay_tokens_user_installation_active.where: "relay_tokens"."installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "relay_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL

idx_relay_tokens_user_device_group_activ.name: idx_relay_tokens_user_device_group_active
idx_relay_tokens_user_device_group_activ.where: "relay_tokens"."device_group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "relay_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL

idx_relay_tokens_user_device_management_.name: idx_relay_tokens_user_device_management_active
idx_relay_tokens_user_device_management_.where: "relay_tokens"."device_management_id" IS NOT NULL AND "relay_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL

relay_tokens_device_group_management_pai.name: relay_tokens_device_group_management_pair_check
relay_tokens_device_group_management_pai.value: ("device_group_id" IS NULL AND "device_management_id" IS NULL) OR ("device_group_id" IS NOT NULL AND "device_management_id" IS NOT NULL)

workspace_document_mutation_entries_stor.name: workspace_document_mutation_entries_storage_uri_check
workspace_document_mutation_entries_stor.value:
(
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_storage_uri" is null or length(trim("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_storage_uri")) > 0) and
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_storage_uri" is null or length(trim("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_storage_uri")) > 0) and
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."destination_before_storage_uri" is null or length(trim("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."destination_before_storage_uri")) > 0)
      )

workspace_document_mutation_entries_mime.name: workspace_document_mutation_entries_mime_type_check
workspace_document_mutation_entries_mime.value:
(
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_mime_type" is null or length(trim("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_mime_type")) > 0) and
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_mime_type" is null or length(trim("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_mime_type")) > 0) and
        (("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_mime_type" is null) = ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_mime_type" is null))
      )

workspace_document_mutation_entries_mime.name: workspace_document_mutation_entries_mime_update_only_check
workspace_document_mutation_entries_mime.value:
(
        "workspace_document_mutation_entries"."mutation_kind" = 'update' or
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_mime_type" is null and "workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_mime_type" is null)
      )

workspace_document_mutation_entries_nonn.name: workspace_document_mutation_entries_nonnegative_values_check
workspace_document_mutation_entries_nonn.value:
(
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_revision" is null or "workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_revision" >= 0) and
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_revision" is null or "workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_revision" >= 0) and
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."destination_before_revision" is null or "workspace_document_mutation_entries"."destination_before_revision" >= 0) and
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_size" is null or "workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_size" >= 0) and
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_size" is null or "workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_size" >= 0) and
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."destination_before_size" is null or "workspace_document_mutation_entries"."destination_before_size" >= 0)
      )

workspace_document_mutation_entries_exac.name: workspace_document_mutation_entries_exact_size_check
workspace_document_mutation_entries_exac.value:
(
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_size" is null or "workspace_document_mutation_entries"."before_size" <= 9007199254740991) and
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_size" is null or "workspace_document_mutation_entries"."after_size" <= 9007199254740991) and
        ("workspace_document_mutation_entries"."destination_before_size" is null or "workspace_document_mutation_entries"."destination_before_size" <= 9007199254740991)
      )
